title: Zaleucus
summary: Raleigh names Zaleucus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Zaleucus, a Lawgiuer in Italie, whose Lawes were very milde. The people among whom he gaue them is a gap. His sonne is unnamed. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVIII, §. V, sig. 377a
